title: MentorChai
subtitle: Virtual Mentorship Platform · Thesis Project
description: A virtual mentorship platform that helps students and mentors connect for scheduled learning sessions. The project brings together mentor discovery, session booking, real-time communication, video calling, notifications, and sandbox payment integration in one Laravel application.

title: PonnoKini
subtitle: Full-Stack E-Commerce Application
description: A Laravel REST API and React storefront covering the shopping journey from product discovery and account verification through checkout, payment, order management, and customer support, with separate administration tools.
